title: Compliance, Data-Residency & EU Data Boundary Watch
blurb: A running record of changes to the Microsoft Learn and Legal pages that govern where and how Copilot processes data — Microsoft 365 Copilot privacy and data protection, the EU Data Boundary, Microsoft 365 data-residency commitments, and Azure OpenAI data-handling terms. These are the pages compliance, privacy and GRC teams cite when certifying Copilot.
